title: Ustalik: ikki ro'yxatni solishtirish
caption:
🔗 Ikki ro'yxatni solishtirish Har idorada bor ish: ombor ro'yxati buxgalteriya hisobi bilan mos kelishi kerak. Qo'lda — yarim kun. Excel formulasi esa «Noutbuk HP 250 G8» bilan «Noutbuk HP250G8» bitta buyum ekanini tanimaydi. 📎 Keyingi xabarlarda: ombor.xlsx (108 qator) va buxgalteriya.xlsx (100 qator), ikkalasi o'ylab topilgan. 1. Yozilishini ko'rsin 
Ikki faylni kod bilan och. Har birida nomlar qanday yozilganini ko'rsat: lotin yoki kirill, qisqartmalar, ortiqcha probel va belgilar.
2. Bir xil ko'rinishga keltirsin 
Nomlarni bir xil ko'rinishga keltir. Asl ustunga tegma, yonida yangi ustun och.
3. Uch guruhga ajratsin 
Ikki ro'yxatni solishtir va uch guruhga ajrat:
aniq mos keldi / o'xshash, lekin ishonch yo'q / faqat bittasida bor.
"O'xshash" guruhida ikkala yozuvni yonma-yon ko'rsat.
Mos kelganlarda soni farq qilsa — alohida belgilab ber.
4. Faylga chiqarsin 
Natijani Excel qilib ber, har guruh alohida varaqda.
Nega uch guruh: xavfli joy — «o'xshash» guruhi. Uni siz hal qilasiz. «O'zing hal qil» desangiz, AI HP 250 G8 bilan HP 250 G9 ni bitta buyum qilib yuboradi. 🔑 O'zingizni tekshiring (bosing): Aniq mos: 54 ta · boshqacha yozilgan, lekin bitta buyum: 34 ta · faqat omborda: 20 ta · faqat buxgalteriyada: 12 ta · soni farq qiladi: 6 ta. 🔒 Ro'yxatda shaxsiy yoki xizmat ma'lumoti bo'lsa — faylni yuklamang. Ustun nomlarini va 2–3 ta o'ylab topilgan qatorni bering, AI dan Excel formulasi yoki makros so'rang: hisob o'z kompyuteringizda bajariladi. 💡 Bugungi yangi bilim: AI dan javob emas, saralash so'rang: aniq / shubhali / yo'q. Shubhalisini o'zingiz hal qilasiz. 🎁 Olib keting: 4 so'rov va ikki mashq fayli — o'z ro'yxatlaringizga ham shu tartib ishlaydi. ➖➖➖ {{CHANNEL}} #ustalik
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Style: clean paper-cut editorial illustration — flat layered shapes with soft shadows, like a neatly filled-in office form. Warm off-white paper background (#F5F2E9), deep navy ink (#141C2B) and one accent colour (#6D3FD0). Calm, trustworthy, no clutter.

1) Top-left: a small solid #6D3FD0 rounded rectangle with white bold uppercase monospace text "USTALIK".
2) Center: two paper lists side by side; thin threads connect matching lines between them — some threads solid, some dashed, a few lines left unconnected. Paper-cut style, matte, generous empty space around it. No people's faces, no real logos, no state emblems or flags.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold navy headline in a characterful grotesque sans-serif, at most three lines: "Ikki ro'yxatni solishtirish"
4) Bottom, above a thin hairline: left small monospace navy text "AI darslar".

Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes. No other text, no watermarks.
notes: Fayllar: jami 120 xil buyum. Tuzoqlar: HP 250 G8 (ikkalasida, boshqacha yozilgan) va HP 250 G9 (faqat omborda); Canon LBP6030 va LBP2900; LG 24MK430 va 27MP400; APC 650VA va 1100VA. Buxgalteriyada 5 ta qiymat matn bo'lib yozilgan — ertangi #ehtiyot posti uchun.
